description:
Sandbox-safe telemetry that is wire compatible with Application Insights, usable from inside the Dataverse plug-in sandbox where the Application Insights SDK cannot load.

Source distribution. The .cs files are compiled into the consuming assembly, for
Dataverse custom workflow activities and on-premises deployments, which cannot
use plug-in packages. For every other consumer, reference JMCL.Telemetry instead.

IMPORTANT: NuGet does not flow contentFiles transitively. Reference ALL of these
packages directly, not just this one:
  JMCL.Telemetry.Sources
title: JMCL.Telemetry.Sources
